Um... "I'm going to the pizza fair with Niimura-senpai, so please pinch-hit for me."
Huh!?
I feel like I'm being used...
Yes, and so this time I will do the commentary.
This is the scenario where Erina regrets her own ugliness.
This is both Erina's good point and her bad point.
Well, should I call it being too earnest?
They do say a lie can be a means to an end, and if it's a lie out of good will, I don't think she should be blamed, but...
I think it's in places like this that she is still childish, and that her personality, which was bad at dealing with people to begin with, seeps out.
Erina was outstandingly smart from before she started school. As in the Wabigoto Arc [Apology], she knew probability calculations and the ecology of flamingos inside and out.
However, smart as she is, it is in the academic sense; in terms of knowing the knack of things and getting along in the world, she gives a somewhat clumsy impression.
When she was little she was almost always with me. As I said in a previous commentary, that is something I should reflect on too.
I should have given her more chances to be with children her own age.
Though really, that sort of thing is for the parents to think about...
I suppose I really did look after her a little too much...
Oh my, a message has arrived from a viewer, so I will read it out.
Um...
“Momo-chin. I always enjoy watching your commentary. You look wonderful at Primavera too.”
Oh my, thank you very much.
“Momo-chin, are you... aware... that you have a sister complex...?”
Huh!? What is this―
Oh, excuse me. Ummm, thank you for a very interesting message.
I do not have a sister complex.
I simply love my sister, and when and where she is and what she is doing, what kind of life she is living, what kinds of things she is eating.
Whether her relationships are going well, what she thinks of me, how much she loves me, how much she wants to brag about her sister to the people around her.
I am only curious about those things, so I do not think there's even a shred of sister complex.
Now, I will introduce the next message.
“Momo-chin. I messaged again right away. Primavera is a wonderful shop. I went before with a friend and was overwhelmed by the atmosphere.”
Oh my, Primavera is a shop you can drop into casually, so please do come again.
Um, the rest of the message is...
“You should refrain from bragging about your figure already. Calling people scrawny, scrawny isn't nice.”
Could this message be...
Oh my, Scrawny-chan, thank you as always for looking after my sister. Rather than wishing for what you lack, I think polishing what you can polish is more constructive, you know?
Another message...!
“Momo-chin. If you don't do the commentary properly, you'll get fired, you know?”
Ho ho ho, that is so... B-but is the problem not with Scrawny-chan, who sends messages like this?
Wait, the scenario's already ending...
Well then, everyone, good day to you.
